description: Header file defining the AppResourceProvider class, which provides resource strings for the CalculatorApp's ViewModel. It includes methods for retrieving resource strings and manages resource loaders.

classes.name: AppResourceProvider
classes.description: A singleton class that provides access to resource strings for the application, including general resource strings and CEngine-specific strings.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AppResourceProvider.

methods.name: GetResourceString
methods.description: Retrieves a resource string based on the provided key.

methods.name: GetCEngineString
methods.description: Retrieves a CEngine-specific resource string based on the provided key.

methods.name: AppResourceProvider (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the AppResourceProvider instance, setting up resource loaders.
